name: Pelican Point Beach
parking: Free lot at the end of Pelican Point Road (40 spaces).
description: A long sandy beach below the bluffs. Busy in summer, so food wrappers and bottle caps pile up near the stairs.

image.alt: A wide sandy beach below tall bluffs, with a wooden staircase down the cliff and calm blue water.

name: Driftwood Cove
parking: Street parking on Cove Lane; arrive early.
description: A small cove where winter storms leave driftwood, rope and fishing gear tangled at the tide line.

image.alt: A small curved cove with pale sand, gray driftwood logs along the tide line and dark rocks at each end.

name: Sandpiper Flats
parking: Visitor center lot (free) with a boardwalk to the meeting point.
description: Tidal marsh and mudflats. Stay on the boardwalk and marked paths: the birds nest here in spring.

image.alt: Green tidal marsh with channels of water winding through it and a wooden boardwalk crossing the flats.

name: North Jetty
parking: Harbor lot B (pay at the machine, free before 9:00).
description: Rocks along the harbor mouth. Lots of fishing line and lures; gloves and sturdy shoes required.

image.alt: A long jetty of gray boulders reaching into the sea at the mouth of a harbor, with waves breaking on the rocks.

name: Otter Creek Mouth
description: Where the creek meets the ocean. Trash washes down after rain and collects in the willows.

image.alt: A creek flowing out of green willows across the beach into the ocean, with low hills behind.

name: Long Strand Beach
parking: State beach lot (day-use fee; the crew covers it for volunteers).
description: Three miles of open beach with a paved path along the dunes. Our biggest cleanups happen here.

image.alt: A very long open beach with grassy dunes and a paved path running beside them toward the horizon.
